title: helm(private): stabilize values schema, init hooks and upgrade/rollback behavior
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Stabilized Helm values schema for private deployment, improved init job hooks, fixed upgrade/rollback ordering to avoid stuck initJobs. No customer-visible API changes.
description:
Motivation: Recent private deployment upgrades intermittently left initJobs in Pending due to ordering and missing validation on values (encryption + node affinity). This PR tightens the values.schema.json, makes init hooks deterministic, and adds a pre/post upgrade job sequence to ensure backups and migrations run reliably.

What this does: - Add stricter values.schema.json for 'private' chart to validate encryption.kms, tolerations, nodeSelector and postgres backup config. - Harden initJob templates: explicit backoffLimit, activeDeadlineSeconds, and ownerReferences to allow safe cleanup on chart uninstall. - Rework Helm hooks ordering: convert problematic pre-upgrade hooks to a ranked sequence (prehook.backup -> prehook.wait-for-init -> upgrade -> posthook.migrate -> posthook.cleanup) to avoid resource contention. - Add a migration-safe rollback path: post-upgrade sanity job triggers a rollback marker if migrations fail, and rollback hook ensures initJobs are re-run in the correct state. - Add e2e upgrade/rollback CI test and local test script for operators. - Update README and values examples to reflect new schema and recommended defaults.

Testing & validation: - Local helm lint + schema validation added to CI. - New e2e job in ci/test-chart.sh exercises upgrade -> migration fail -> rollback path. - Manual staging upgrade performed on internal cluster (redwood-private-staging) to validate timing/ordering; captured logs and pod events.

Checklist: - [x] Schema changes documented and backward compatible where possible - [x] Init hook timeouts set with reasonable defaults - [x] CI tests added and green after fixes - [x] Release notes prepared - [x] No breaking API surface for existing installs (migration path covered)

Related: ENG-4321 (upgrade stability), ENG-4380 (initjob cleanup), SUP-1192 (customer support case that motivated stricter validation).
